## Copper Dragon, Mature Adult (CR 13)

**XP** 25,600  
CG Large dragon (earth)  
**Init** +5; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +24; **Aura** frightful presence (210 ft., DC 22)  


**Defense**


**AC** 32, touch 10, flat-footed 31 (+1 Dex, +22 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 289 (17d12+85)  
**Fort** +15, **Ref** +11, **Will** +14  
**Defensive Abilities** uncanny dodge; **DR** 10/magic; **Immune** acid, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 24  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor); climb stone  
**Melee** bite +25 (2d6+12/19–20), 2 claws +24 (1d8+8/19–20), tail slap +19 (1d8+12), 2 wings +19 (1d6+4)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft. (10 ft. with bite)  
**Special Attacks** breath weapon (80-ft. line, DC 23, 14d6 acid), slow breath  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 17th; concentration +21)  

At will— *[grease](../../magic/spells/grease.md)* (DC 15), *[hideous laughter](../../magic/spells/hideous-laughter.md)* (DC 16), *[stone shape](../../magic/spells/stone-shape.md)*  

**Sorcerer Spells Known** (CL 9th; concentration +13)  

4th (5/day)—*[confusion](../../magic/spells/confusion.md)*, *[rainbow pattern](../../magic/spells/rainbow-pattern.md)*  
3rd (7/day)—*[dispel magic](../../magic/spells/dispel-magic.md)*, *[haste](../../magic/spells/haste.md)*, *[major image](../../magic/spells/major-image.md)* (DC 17)  
2nd (7/day)—*[glitterdust* ](../../magic/spells/glitterdust.md)(DC 16), *[invisibility](../../magic/spells/invisibility.md)*, *[phantom trap](../../magic/spells/phantom-trap.md)*, *[see invisibility](../../magic/spells/see-invisibility.md)*  
1st (7/day)—*[alarm](../../magic/spells/alarm.md)*, *[identify](../../magic/spells/identify.md)*, *[magic missile](../../magic/spells/magic-missile.md)*, *[shield](../../magic/spells/shield.md)*, *[silent image* ](../../magic/spells/silent-image.md)(DC 15)  
0 (at will)—*[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[ghost sound* ](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)(DC 14), *[light](../../magic/spells/light.md)*, *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[message](../../magic/spells/message.md)*, *[open/close](../../magic/spells/open-close.md)*, *[prestidigitation](../../magic/spells/prestidigitation.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*  


**Statistics**


**Str** 27, **Dex** 12, **Con** 21, **Int** 18, **Wis** 19, **Cha** 18  
**Base Atk** +17; **CMB** +26 (+30 trip); **CMD** 37 (43 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Combat Expertise, Greater Trip, Improved Critical (bite, claw), Improved Initiative, Improved Trip, Improved Vital Strike, Vital Strike, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Bluff +24, Craft (traps) +29 (with improvised tools), Diplomacy +24, Fly +15, Perception +24 (+31 vs. traps), Perform (comedy) +24, Sense Motive +24, Stealth +17, Use Magic Device +24  
**Languages** Common, Draconic, Elven, Gnome, Halfling  
**SQ** trap master  


**Special Abilities**


**Climb Stone (Ex)** A copper dragon can climb on stone surfaces as though using the *spider climb* spell.  

**Slow Breath (Su)** Instead of a line of acid, a copper dragon can breathe a cone of slowing gas. Those in the cone must make a Fortitude save or be slowed (as per the spell *slow*) for 1d6 rounds plus 1 round per age category of the dragon.  

**Trap Master (Ex)** A juvenile or older copper dragon receives a +1 bonus per age category on Craft (traps) and Perception checks made to locate a trap. Upon becoming a mature adult, he can also use Disable Device to disarm magic traps as if he had the rogue’s Trapfinding class feature.  



**Ecology**


**Environment** warm hills  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** triple
